[[File:Angus.png|250px|thumb|Angus]] '''Angus''' (Japanese: '''アッキー''' ''Akkie'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]''. He is the brother of [[Getty]] and [[Betty]]. He and his siblings all entered the [[Clubsplosion]] tournament together, and he became {{Ash}}'s first opponent. Since his hairstyle is reminiscent of his Pokémon's, [[Ash's Scraggy]] used {{m|Leer}} on him after it initially mistook Angus as the opponent instead of {{p|Simisage}}. Angus proved to be brutal in combat, having Simisage unleash a barrage of {{m|Low Sweep}}s following Scraggy's injury after a failed {{m|High Jump Kick}}. However, he did not count on Scraggy learning {{m|Focus Blast}}, which stopped his Simisage from finishing him off with {{m|Giga Impact}}. This ultimately led to his loss. He made a brief appearance in ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]'', where he and Getty cheered Betty on as she was preparing for her battle with Ash. Angus is often seen combing his hair even when he is battling. His style and mannerisms are synonymous with classic 1950s {{wp|Hairstyles in the 1950s|pompadour}} culture. His battle strategy is centered on winning through the use of sheer power alongside Simisage's acrobatic dodges. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Angus |pkmn=Simisage |type1=Grass |img=Angus Simisage.png |epnum=BW070 |epname=The Clubsplosion Begins! |vajp=Akeno Watanabe |vaen=Eli James |desc={{p|Simisage}} is Angus's only known Pokémon. It battled [[Ash's Scraggy]] during the first round of the [[Clubsplosion]]. It initially had the upper hand against Scraggy by stepping on his bagging pants and then using Low Sweep on him repeatedly. However, just before it was to defeat its foe with a powerful Giga Impact, Scraggy countered with his newly-learned {{m|Focus Blast}} which was enough to throw it off for the rest of the battle. It was intimidated by Scraggy's {{m|Leer}} and then knocked out by a {{m|Headbutt}}. Simisage's known moves are {{m|Seed Bomb}}, {{m|Low Sweep}}, {{m|Shadow Claw}}, and {{m|Giga Impact}}.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Angus has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Clubsplosion]] - Top 16 (''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{grass color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=赤羽根健治 ''Kenji Akabane'' |en=George Bailey |es_la=Alejandro Orozco |pt_br=Daniel Garcia |es_eu=Jorge Saudinós |pl=Michał Podsiadło}} ==Trivia== * Angus's Japanese name comes from his Pokémon's Japanese name, ''Yanakkie''.
